notes: Produced a PID controller tuned for the slightly advanced front-center and outer sensors, maintaining sensor size and wheel track for stability. Observation request includes key metrics to verify improved forward sensing and control smoothness, based on previous iteration's excellent zero line loss and low oscillation.
rationale: The previous iteration's geometry with six sensors (including a front-center sensor at y=0.065 m), sensor size 0.016 m, wheel track 0.14 m, and refined sensor positions showed excellent performance with zero line loss and low steering oscillation on both oval and s-bend tracks. Integration feedback confirms this layout is well optimized for forward line sensing and lateral coverage. To further improve anticipation of line curvature and balance sensor coverage, I slightly move the front-center sensor forward to y=0.07 m and shift the left and right outer sensors slightly forward to y=0.05 m. All other geometry parameters remain unchanged to maintain stable dynamics and proven performance. I expect sustained zero line loss, reduced steering oscillation, and improved control smoothness. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, max_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these improvements and ensure continued robust line following.
